name: Guam

findings.controller: GTA Teleguam (owned by Huntsman Family Investments)
findings.summary: GTA broke ground on its 4MW Alupang Tier 3 data centre and cable landing station in Tamuning; in late 2024 it was still under construction and named landing site for the MYUS cable.
findings.analyst_inference: Owner-operator GTA is US-owned (Huntsman Family Investments; Stonepeak invested USD 200m in GTA in late 2023, not tied to this facility in sources), and Guam is a US territory, so pole us. Tier 4 because construction began; completion (planned late 2024) not confirmed. Not AI-specific: a carrier-neutral colocation and landing facility.

findings.controller: US Navy / US Marine Corps (NAVFAC Pacific)
findings.summary: NAVFAC Pacific awarded a firm-fixed-price contract of about USD 289.8m for a consolidated communications centre, two warehouses and fibre cabling at Camp Blaz, with completion expected by March 2029.
findings.analyst_inference: US military owner-operator in a US territory, so pole us. Opened sources describe a communications centre, not a data centre; the unopened DCD headline (Oct 2024) calls the Camp Blaz project a data center, possibly the same project. Builder nationality not stated (Kajima is a Japanese firm name, unverified here). Medium because relevance to the AI stack is indirect.
